title: Glowing wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- strap top -->
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='24' height='22' rx='5' fill='#7a4b2a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a86f42'/>
  <!-- strap holes -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='2' fill='#5a3420'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='2' fill='#5a3420'/>
  <!-- strap bottom -->
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='24' height='22' rx='5' fill='#7a4b2a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a86f42'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='28' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffe48a'/>
  <!-- case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='23' fill='#ffe48a'/>
  <!-- dial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='19' fill='#223a5e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='16' fill='#2d4d7a'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='35' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <rect x='49' y='60' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <rect x='35' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <rect x='60' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='39' width='3' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#ff7ad9'/>
  <rect x='49' y='48' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7dff9e'/>
  <!-- center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
